name: Recursive Parameter Space Voxelization for Catmull-Clark Subdivision Surfaces
aliases: Voxelization of Solids Represented by CCSSs
definition: A voxelization technique that converts a free-form object represented by a Catmull-Clark subdivision surface (CCSS) into a set of voxels by recursively subdividing the 2D parameter space of surface patches and sampling 3D points, rather than subdividing 3D object space. This ensures leak-free results for closed objects when a 3D flooding operation is performed.
summary: This method voxelizes Catmull-Clark surfaces by recursively subdividing the 2D parameter space, ensuring leak-free results while avoiding expensive 3D distance computations.
